nodes.name: channelCreate.js
nodes.summary: channelCreate event handler that posts a formatted log embed to the guild's configured log channel whenever a channel is created, identifying the responsible moderator from the audit log and titling the entry by channel type.

nodes.name: channelDelete.js
nodes.summary: channelDelete event handler that logs deleted channels to the configured log channel, resolving the moderator who deleted the channel from the ChannelDelete audit log entry.

nodes.name: channelUpdate.js
nodes.summary: channelUpdate event handler that detects channel renames, topic creations/updates/removals, and category reassignments, posting before/after log embeds attributed to the audit-log executor.

nodes.name: guildBanAdd.js
nodes.summary: guildBanAdd event handler that logs member bans to the members log channel, including the banned user and the moderator identified via the MemberBanAdd audit log.

nodes.name: guildBanRemove.js
nodes.summary: guildBanRemove event handler that logs member unbans to the members log channel with the unbanned user and the audit-log executor who lifted the ban.

nodes.name: guildMemberAdd.js
nodes.summary: Member join handler that logs new members with invite attribution (resolving the used invite from cached invite uses, or the bot-add audit log for bots) and sends a configurable welcome message containing a getting-started guide.

nodes.name: guildMemberRemove.js
nodes.summary: guildMemberRemove event handler that posts a departure log embed with the leaving member's tag and ID to the members log channel.

nodes.name: guildMemberUpdate.js
nodes.summary: guildMemberUpdate event handler that logs member changes — role grants/removals, guild ownership transfers, and nickname changes — to the members log channel with audit-log moderator attribution.

nodes.name: guildUpdate.js
nodes.summary: guildUpdate event handler that logs guild setting changes — AFK channel, description, and name updates — to the guild-updates log channel with before/after details and moderator attribution from the audit log.

nodes.name: messageDelete.js
nodes.summary: messageDelete event handler that logs deleted messages with author, channel, send time, and a content snapshot to the messages log channel, skipping uncached messages without an author.

nodes.name: messageUpdate.js
nodes.summary: messageUpdate event handler that logs edited messages by comparing old and new content (truncated to 1024 characters) and posting a before/after embed to the messages log channel.

nodes.name: roleCreate.js
nodes.summary: roleCreate event handler that logs newly created roles with the responsible moderator resolved from the RoleCreate audit log entry.

nodes.name: roleDelete.js
nodes.summary: roleDelete event handler that logs deleted roles with the moderator identified through the guild audit log.

nodes.name: roleUpdate.js
nodes.summary: roleUpdate event handler that detects role icon, color, name, and permission changes, posting before/after log embeds attributed to the audit-log executor.

nodes.name: voiceStateUpdate.js
nodes.summary: voiceStateUpdate event handler covering voice joins/leaves, server mute and deafen toggles, streaming and camera changes, and cross-channel moves with member counts, all logged to the voice log channel.

nodes.name: db.js
nodes.summary: Central settings persistence layer that routes guild-scoped keys (anti-protection toggles, limits, whitelists, language, log channels) through a JSON-backed cache while falling back to a raw key-value store, plus typo normalization and projects.json load/save helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a pro.db key-value library with hand-rolled JSON files, using file mtime comparison to invalidate an in-memory cache instead of reloading on every read.

nodes.name: proDbGet
nodes.summary: Reads a key from the JSON-backed pro.db store using an mtime-validated in-memory cache so unchanged files are never re-parsed.

nodes.name: proDbSet
nodes.summary: Writes a key to pro.db, updates the local cache, refreshes the cache mtime, and logs write failures without throwing.

nodes.name: proDbDelete
nodes.summary: Deletes a key from pro.db and the in-memory cache, short-circuiting when the key is not present.

nodes.name: get
nodes.summary: Resolves a settings key by splitting the guild prefix and routing language, log-channel, punishment, limit, whitelist, and anti-protection settings through guild settings with fallback to the raw key-value store.

nodes.name: set
nodes.summary: Persists a settings key by writing guild-scoped anti, language, log-channel, and punishment settings into the guild settings file, and everything else into the raw key-value store.

nodes.name: del
nodes.summary: Removes a settings key, deleting guild-scoped settings from the persisted guild settings file and other keys from the raw store.

nodes.name: loadProjects
nodes.summary: Loads and caches projects.json, recovering from read or parse errors by resetting the cache to an empty object and rewriting the file.

nodes.name: saveProjects
nodes.summary: Serializes the projects object back to projects.json asynchronously, logging any write failure.
